result.topic_en: Division of the residues 1,…,p−1 into three classes for primes p ≡ 1 (mod 3) written as p = A² + 3B², with statements on how x, fx, f²x (with f a cube root of unity mod p) fall into consecutive classes, and worked examples for p = 7, 13, 19, 31, 37, 43.

methods.what: Theorem: the multiples (3n−m)x and 2mx lie in two consecutive classes of the threefold division mod p
methods.quote: 3) Theorem. Die Zahlen $(3n-m)x$; $2mx$ [-...-] gehören in zwei auf einander folgende Klassen.

methods.what: Corollary: f ≡ (3n−m)/(2m) is a nontrivial cube root of unity mod p, so x, fx, f²x lie in three consecutive classes in reversed order
methods.quote:
4) Also wenn $\frac{3n-m}{2m} \equiv f$, also $1+f+ff \equiv 0 \pmod{p}$, $1 \equiv f^3 \pmod{p}$
so gehören x, und die Reste von fx, ffx in drei in umgekehrter Ordnung auf einander folgende Klassen.

methods.what: Representation of primes p ≡ 1 mod 3 as A² + 3B², with an accompanying triple of integers summing to zero, and the explicit three-class division of 1..p−1

items.quote: 3) Theorem. Die Zahlen $(3n-m)x$; $2mx$ [-...-] gehören in zwei auf einander folgende Klassen.
items.english: 3) Theorem. The numbers (3n−m)x and 2mx belong to two consecutive classes.

items.quote:
4) Also wenn $\frac{3n-m}{2m} \equiv f$, also $1+f+ff \equiv 0 \pmod{p}$, $1 \equiv f^3 \pmod{p}$
so gehören x, und die Reste von fx, ffx in drei in umgekehrter Ordnung auf einander folgende Klassen.
items.english: 4) Hence if (3n−m)/(2m) ≡ f, so that 1+f+f² ≡ 0 (mod p) and 1 ≡ f³ (mod p), then x and the residues of fx, f²x belong to three classes that follow one another in reversed order.
